author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: shadow_a_q and shadow_b_q are one-stage followers of the same u_sync output; comb_q's cone holds a single synchronizer influence (duplicate copies of one launch bit), so CDC-010 does not trigger; CDC-047 is exempt (one chain whose last stage fans out). CDC-013 is INFO (20 ns vs 8 ns).

author_reading.rationale: Clean depth-2 synchronizer of an uncomputed 20 ns -> 8 ns bit; the stage-2 output fans out afterwards to two destination flops and a downstream OR of those copies, a single-source echo.

labels.rationale: The shadows derive from the same completed synchronizer output and update together. Their OR combines copies of one synchronized influence, with no second independent chain.

Single-bit source src_ctrl_q (src_clk, 20.0 ns) is synchronized once into dst_clk (8.0 ns) through 2-stage synchronizer u_sync (output sync_s). The true and inverted follower registers shadow_a_q and shadow_b_q both derive from the same synchronized output sync_s rather than multiple independent crossings, so neither CDC-047 nor CDC-010 triggers.
